mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,priority,enabled,fulfillment_enabled fulfillmentEnabled FROM warehouse WHERE enabled=TRUE AND fulfillment_enabled=TRUE ORDER BY priority,id

SELECT CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) warehouseId,CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) skuId,on_hand onHand,reserved,quarantine FROM stock_balance WHERE warehouse_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND sku_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY warehouse_id,sku_id
